name: logowright
description: Logos designed as clean SVG with typefaces chosen from real Google Fonts on a specimen sheet, exported from one brand.json to SVG and PNG logos, dark and one-colour versions, favicons, app and PWA icons, a webmanifest, printable brand guidelines (US Letter PDF), a light and dark website colour palette (OKLCH scales, CSS, Tailwind and design tokens), vector PDF logos, social images, an email signature, business card, slide template, social post templates, portfolio and Ko-fi covers with an icon and alt text, the brand's own license and usage policy, and one zip of the kit. Also makes icon sets for existing logos.
